answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The violet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the hollow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the river of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
